definitions.explanation: The act of replacing one person or thing with another in rotation.
The changing of workers at the end of a work period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{交替|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交替|こうたい}しながら⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧{交替|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦になってきた→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: Shift work puts a strain on the body, so health management is important.

notes:
{交替|こうたい} means to alternate or take turns, with a focus on rotation and cyclical replacement.

WRITING:
Also commonly written as ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧. The two spellings are largely interchangeable in modern Japanese, though {交替|こうたい} emphasizes rotation/alternation and {交代|こうたい} emphasizes replacement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交替|こうたい}する: to alternate, to take turns
- {交替|こうたい}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: shift work
- ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧{交替|こうたい}: generational change
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{交替|こうたい}: player substitution
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧を{交替|こうたい}する: to take turns driving

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{交替|こうたい}で⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to do something in shifts/turns
- {交替|こうたい}の⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: changeover time

This word functions as both a noun and a する verb.
